configurations.name: web-preview
configurations.//: The production build (npm run build first): what Render serves. Used by npm run audit:home.

configurations.name: look-frozen
configurations.//: A FROZEN production build for the design-language pixel gate (docs/design-language/PLAN.md Phase 0/1): copy a build into ../.mk-look-builds/serve, then run the audit with E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4174. Source edits never reach it mid-run.

configurations.name: look-candidate
configurations.//: The candidate build beside look-frozen, for side-by-side computed-style checks.

configurations.name: web-crosssite
configurations.//: SPA on localhost, API on 127.0.0.1: two different SITES, so the API's cookies are third-party, exactly as on Render. Reproduces what iPhones (WebKit ITP) see.

configurations.name: api
configurations.//: Plain node, not nodemon: a watcher restarting mid-run is indistinguishable from the API being down.

configurations.name: api-local-check
configurations.//: The API on the LOCAL mongod (a throwaway database, never Atlas) with email suppressed, for end-to-end browser checks. Run `npm run prepare:db` with the same MONGODB_URI first. .env is untouched: dotenv never overrides a variable that is already set.

configurations.name: api-metrics
configurations.//: The api entry with METRICS_TOKEN=dev, so GET /metrics answers locally (curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer dev'). Leaves .env untouched.

configurations.name: api-desk-check
configurations.//: The API on a throwaway LOCAL database with the walk-in desk's OCR sidecar (ocr/, started separately on 8090 with OCR_TOKEN=test-token) and a test discount code. Run prepare:db with the same MONGODB_URI first.

configurations.name: api-stats-check
configurations.//: The API on a throwaway LOCAL database seeded with four meets of published scores, for checking the profile Stats tabs and the Judge fairness board.

configurations.name: api-team-check
configurations.//: Throwaway local DB for the team-per-level browser check (seeded outside the repo).

configurations.name: api-e2e-local
configurations.//: The nightly e2e chain's API, locally: throw-away mallakhamb_local_e2e, no mail, discount on, rate limit off. Run setupApi.js against :5001 with the same env.

configurations.name: api-e2e-browse
configurations.//: Port 5000 on the local e2e chain database (mallakhamb_local_e2e), to look at a fully seeded season in the browser.

configurations.name: api-sa-check
configurations.//: Throwaway LOCAL clone of mallakhamb_local_e2e for the Super Admin Fix/History browser check (docs/superadmin-control-plan.md). Owner sign-in is in Server/sa-check.local (git-ignored).
